top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 physiology prize to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov rests on a mature, independently confirmed arc from proglucagon processing and the active GLP-1(7-36) amide through human incretin physiology to outcome-proven benefit in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The physiology-led citation credits the discoveries without claiming the drug engineering, and the three-laureate allocation fits the original-discovery scope. No award is clearly inferior to a prize this well established.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; the profile's only flagged connection (spatial transcriptomics co-authorship, Rickard Sandberg co-authorships) does not touch the GLP-1 proposal
